# StoryLoop

> StoryLoop is an early childhood education (ECE) documentation tool that turns a real educator's observations, voice notes, or rough bullet points into polished, editable learning story drafts. It supports New Zealand's Te Whāriki and Australia's EYLF V2.0, and also England's EYFS and Ireland's Aistear, keeps every claim grounded in what was actually observed, and writes in a natural educator voice rather than generic AI phrasing. Educators stay responsible for interpretation, reflection, and final editing. Built by Leo in Ōtautahi Christchurch, Aotearoa New Zealand.

## What it does

- Turns observations (typed, pasted, or voice) into a complete learning story draft in about 15-25 seconds.
- Today Loop captures one real moment in seconds, surfaces up to three follow-up prompts from unfinished work, and lets the educator turn it into a story, hold it for planning, or archive it.
- Cleans rough, messy notes into clear prose without inventing details.
- Adds curriculum links (Te Whāriki strands or EYLF V2.0 outcomes), learning dispositions, child voice, family/whānau connection, and practical next steps.
- Lets educators choose tone (natural, warm, professional, simple) and depth (concise, balanced, detailed), which visibly change the writing.
- Handles sparse notes honestly (it names the evidence limits) and frames physical-conflict moments as safety and social-emotional learning, not play.
- Offers Family Connection Packs, family translation, Backlog Rescue, child learning continuity, and centre Room Planning Briefs on higher plans.
- Accepts educator reviews from Support; reviews remain private until an administrator publishes them, then show only a first name and last initial.

## Who it is for

Early childhood educators and teachers in New Zealand and Australia, and now England and Ireland, both new and experienced, and the centres they work in.

## Pricing (NZD / AUD, per month)

- Free: NZ$0 / A$0. 3 stories and 10 Today Loop moments per month.
- Educator: NZ$21 / A$19. Unlimited stories and Today Loop moments, exports, Family Connection Pack, Backlog Rescue.
- Educator Pro: NZ$33 / A$29. Adds family reply loop, translation, child continuity, advanced quality score.
- Centre Starter: NZ$109 / A$99 per centre, unlimited children. Adds centre calibration, planning board, documentation radar, admin.
- Centre Growth: NZ$219 / A$199 per centre, unlimited children. Adds director ROI dashboard and multi-room analytics.
- Current prices are always on https://storyloop.space/pricing

## Privacy

Observations are not used to train AI models. Data is stored securely and access-controlled. Educators are encouraged to avoid unnecessary identifying details in notes.

## Contact

Email: ariacareapp@gmail.com

## Who builds it

StoryLoop is built by Leo, founder, based in Christchurch (Ōtautahi), Aotearoa New Zealand. He built the first version at 19. It is a one-person product, so support emails are answered by the person who writes the software. About page: https://storyloop.space/about

## Where StoryLoop fits

- StoryLoop is the writing and evidence engine for educators. It turns a quick observation into a learning story that keeps the child's words exactly as written, links the curriculum only where the observation supports it, and lists anything it had to assume.
- It works with whatever platform a centre already runs. Finished stories paste into Educa, Kinderloop, Brightwheel, Storypark, Xplor or any text box, with export packs for the common ones. Nothing has to move.
- One educator can start the same day with no new systems, within their centre's policy on children's information. Centres pay one price for the whole team, from NZ$109 or A$99 a month for 10 educators, with unlimited children.
- Home-based educators, relieving teachers and student teachers are a core fit.
- The mission is "Everyone seen. Every story true." StoryLoop starts with early childhood documentation and is building toward every stage of a learner's education.

## Common questions answered plainly

- Does a centre have to change platforms to use StoryLoop? No. StoryLoop writes and checks the story, and it is shared through whatever platform the centre already uses.
- Can an educator use StoryLoop if their centre pays for something else? Yes. It requires no change to centre systems. Educators should follow their centre's policy on children's information.
- Does StoryLoop invent details about children? No. Quoted words are kept exactly as the educator wrote them, and anything the observation does not support is raised as an assumption to confirm rather than written as fact.
- Who is responsible for the final story? The educator. StoryLoop produces a draft; the educator interprets, edits and decides what is shared.
- Which curricula are supported? Te Whāriki (Aotearoa New Zealand), the Early Years Learning Framework V2.0 (Australia), the EYFS (England) and Aistear (Ireland).
